lines.reference: Snacks, popcorn, air-popped (same per gram as the kernels) — USDA FDC 167959: 387 kcal / 100 g
Oil, sunflower, linoleic (less than 60%) — USDA FDC 171017: 884 kcal / 100 g

notes: Assumptions: ½ cup (125 ml) of kernels ~100 g, valued as air-popped popcorn (the same energy per gram as the kernels); all the oil is taken up. Sanity check: USDA oil-popped white popcorn (FDC 170247) is 500 kcal/100 g; ours is 493 kcal/100 g of finished popcorn.
